description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the current Gram HSW-C compact multi-lane heat-seal wrapper in the ten-lane QC-floor configuration.
dimensionBasis: No public HSW-C general-arrangement drawing or installed dimensions were found. The 5.8 x 2.7 m closed footprint and 3.1 m height are estimated from the supplied current render using a 1.05 m product working height, 0.18 m lane pitch, leveling feet, and common sanitary frame sections. The 3.168 m open-service width includes the raised far-side hatches and near-side operator panel modeled from the same view. Replace this scale when measured or GA dimensions are available.

references.use: Primary target for the ten-lane configuration, overall silhouette, separate infeed and foil-roll bank, transfer bed, guard cage, open service hatches, top cabinets, support frame, and stainless finish.

Current product identity, up-to-16-lane range, compact line integration, servo-driven foil transport, linear rail motion, pneumatic knife movement, PIP control, tool-free format components, and roof-mounted pneumatic/electrical equipment.
Second official copy of the current overall configuration. The high-contrast edge treatment clarifies frame, guard, and station boundaries.
Highest-resolution source for lane hardware, foil rolls, transfer slats, guarded cell, roof cabinets, opened mesh hatches, and leveling feet.
Confirms up to 25 strokes per minute, paper or film use, automatic operation, hermetic heat sealing, and integration between frozen-product transfer and outfeed.

recognizableFeatures: Ten side-by-side product lanes with a separate foil-roll and format-box bank.
Long open transfer bed leading into a tall rectangular wrapping cell.
Black square-grid safety guards with two raised service hatches.
Two large stainless pneumatic and electrical cabinets above the guarded cell.
Banks of linear sealing and pneumatic knife hardware across all ten lanes.
Open stainless lower skid with cross braces and adjustable sanitary feet.

confidence.area: Current ten-lane silhouette and visible operator-side components
confidence.note: The supplied image and two manufacturer downloads show the same configured render at high resolution, but from one perspective.
The dimensions are image-derived. No public GA drawing or installed measurement was found.

confidence.area: Lane count, foil bank, transfer bed, guard cage, roof cabinets, and open hatch placement
confidence.note: These items are clear in the supplied render and match the floor-plan requirement for ten lanes.

confidence.area: Far side, internal film routing, knife profile, drives, and controls
confidence.note: Hidden systems remain schematic and should not guide fabrication, installation, maintenance, or safety work.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization and BTC wrapper selection
usage.notes: This is a visual floor-plan asset, not a fabrication, installation, guarding, controls, maintenance, or safety model.
